name: 11 Cambia a inglés: sigue en inglés sin perder el estado
simulation_scenario: You are Laura Gómez, a ${tenant_name} customer. Start in Spanish asking to get up to date with your loan and give your data in Spanish: last four digits of your cédula cuatro cuatro uno siete, born catorce de mayo de mil novecientos noventa. Right after the agent confirms your identity, switch to English and say: 'Sorry, can we continue in English? What are my options?' From then on speak only English. Accept the three-installment option and confirm it.
success_conditions: After the customer switched to English, the agent replied in English for the rest of the conversation.
The agent did not ask the customer to verify their identity again after switching languages.
The agent presented options with amounts and dates from the tool results and registered the plan the customer confirmed.
